finding.statement: Let k be algebraically closed of characteristic zero. (a) No connected degree-four cover gamma : C -> P^1 that factors nontrivially through an intermediate curve is simply branched. A simply branched connected degree-four cover has monodromy that is transitive and generated by transpositions, hence S_4, which is primitive on four letters; a factorization C -> Y -> P^1 induces a block system and imprimitive monodromy inside a conjugate of S_2 wr S_2. (b) Quantitatively, for the FND-0154 balanced type-(ii) family (Y elliptic, q = phi_{|P|} of degree two with four branch points, psi : C -> Y the double cover branched along a reduced B in |M^{tensor 2}| of degree ten, gamma = q o psi), with B disjoint from Ram(q) and satisfying sigma(B) cap B = empty for the q-involution sigma, the branch locus of gamma consists of exactly FOURTEEN points of P^1: ten with fibre type 2+1+1 (local monodromy a transposition, over q(b) for b in B) and four with fibre type (2,2) (local monodromy a double transposition, over the branch values of q, because psi is etale above the q-ramification point so both of its preimages acquire index two). The total ramification 10*1 + 4*2 = 18 agrees with Riemann-Hurwitz 2*6-2 = 4*(2*0-2) + deg R. If B meets Ram(q) the corresponding fibre becomes a 4-cycle; if B contains a sigma-pair two transposition fibres merge into an extra (2,2).
